No outbound (export) shipment row with an Indian origin port and foreign destination was visible on the free view. domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report revenue split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, eximpedia.app and volza.com all returned HTTP 403; ril.com business pages tried (/businesses/consumer-retail/reliance-brands, /ar2023-24/business-review-retail.html) returned HTTP 404. web_search was unavailable (connection refused), so no domestic supply record was located. Not public in the sources reachable within this check — recorded as null, not inferred.
note: Role: importer/distributor of international fashion brands (Sandro, Hugo Boss, Tod's, Hunkemoller, Charles Tyrwhitt appear as suppliers), i.e. a buyer-side trader/retailer, not an exporter. Declared HS 610910 (cotton T-shirts) is inconsistent with the observed trade: the visible records are HS 61044300, 62089290, 61052020, 61083210 — knitted dresses, bath robes, men's shirts/polos, nightwear. Per project rules this is NOT grounds for rejection; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actual observed codes (verdict accepted_hs_corrected). Industry claimed as 'food & FMCG' also does not match the observed apparel/fashion trade — flag for correction, not rejection. Export status: no export shipment found in the free customs view; the 100,933-record figure is an import-side counter and must not be read as export volume. Export volume and revenue: null (not public in reachable sources). Domestic supply: no confirmed record found — 'следов поставок не найдено' on the domestic side within this check, stated as unknown rather than softened to conditionally accepted.
